# bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/build_model

## Summary

Build a Molecular Dynamics AutoEncoder (MDAE) PyTorch model.

Builds a PyTorch autoencoder from the given properties.

Nextflow adapter of the [BuildModel](https://biobb-pytorch.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mdae.html#module-biobb_pytorch.mdae.build_model) building block of [biobb_pytorch](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pytorch) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PYTORCH_BUILD_MODEL } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/build_model'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PYTORCH_BUILD_MODEL(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_stats_pt_path` | yes | pt | Path to the input model statistics file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_model_pth_path` | no, opt-in | pth | Path to save the model in .pth format |
| `versions_biobb_pytorch` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pytorch', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of BuildModel properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_model_pth_path: 'pth']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pytorch container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PYTORCH_BUILD_MODEL' {
        ext.properties = [model_type: 'AutoEncoder']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_type` | string | "AutoEncoder" | Name of the model class to instantiate (must exist in biobb_pytorch.mdae.models). |
| `n_cvs` | integer | 1 | Dimensionality of the latent space. |
| `encoder_layers` | array | "[16]" | List of integers representing the number of neurons in each encoder layer. |
| `decoder_layers` | array | "[16]" | List of integers representing the number of neurons in each decoder layer. |
| `options` | object | {"norm_in": {"mode": "min_max"}} | Additional options (e.g. norm_in, optimizer, loss_function, device, etc.). |
